note: Straight-alpha RGBA layers, far to near. Each PNG includes the overscan margin; place its top-left at `offset` in painting coordinates. depth: suggested parallax factor (0 = sky ... 1 = nearest). flat.png = all layers composited with normal blending.

layers.name: sky
layers.note: gold sky with high clouds; tileable in x (scroll slowest)

layers.name: cloud_bank
layers.note: bank of sculpted cumulus along the bottom; tileable in x (scroll medium)

layers.name: wisps
layers.note: fast near cloud wisps (speed lines of vapour); tileable in x (scroll fastest)

layers.name: sun_glow
layers.note: SCREEN-FIXED overlay (do not scroll): the off-frame sun at the upper right; use screen or add blending

scroll_note: scroll sky slowest, cloud_bank medium, wisps fastest; sun_glow fixed to the camera
